text:
Riya (AE): kicking off Lantern migration POC thread. they want a drop-in replacement for CompetitorX. main asks: prompt parity, cost delta, and SOC2 + deletion SLA. who can drive the probe harness?
Nikhil (Solutions Eng): I will. plan: 3 buckets - golden business prompts (100), edge cases (50), format/JSON outputs (50). will run deterministic seeds and collect tokenized diffs.
Priya (SRE): staging cluster ready. give me expected peak qps and whether we need TCP-level headers mimicked. also confirm whether to replay headers from their recorded traffic.
Riya (AE): Lantern asked us to mimic their X-Client-ID header and preserve conversation_id.
Nikhil (Solutions Eng): parity gates I'm proposing:
- semantic_match >= 0.92 (BERT-sim on golden prompts)
- json_schema_validity >= 99% on structured outputs
- behavioral_flip_rate <= 4% (where answer category changes)
- p90 latency < 450ms under 95th perc load
- effective cost_per_1k <= 0.75x CompetitorX during POC
Also include a small subjective blind eval: 30 pairs, if reviewers pick CompetitorX > 65% we fail style parity.
Claire (Product): note tokenizer nuance: CompetitorX escapes newlines differently and has a trailing system marker. recommend a compatibility shim that normalizes newlines, removes vendor markers, and re-inserts our canonical system message. keep it opt-in per project.
Nikhil (Solutions Eng): shim example:
```yaml
compat:
  normalize_newlines: true
  remove_vendor_markers: ["\u2063SYS\u2063"]
  inject_system: "You are a concise, helpful assistant."
  token_truncation: preserve_last_turn
```
Omar (Security): checklist from Lantern27s questionnaire: SOC2 type II, egress IPs, encryption in transit + at rest, KMS integration, SSO + SCIM, subprocessor list, data deletion certification. they specifically requested 72-hour deletion confirmation for user PII. legal ops will need to sign off on deviation.
Jason (Sales): POC commercial asks: 3-week trial, staging credits, and a scope-limited SLA for perf. I suggest $1,500 in credits + a refundable $500 ramp fee for network testing. thoughts?
Priya (SRE): perf window scheduled for 2024-05-10T02:00:00Z. infra-bot deployed the canary and posted endpoints. egress IPs: 34.201.99.10, 34.201.99.11. staging URL: https://staging.redwood.dev/lantern-poc. logs: https://infra/logs/lantern-poc.
infra-bot: deployment succeeded. creds in 1Password: /teams/sales/lantern-poc.
Nikhil (Solutions Eng): sample comparison curl (harness):
```bash
# replay to CompetitorX (recorded)
curl -s -X POST https://api.competitorx/v1/chat -H "Authorization: Bearer $CX" -H "X-Client-ID: lantern-prod" -d '{"conversation_id":"abc123","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Convert this bullet list to JSON"}]}'
# our staging endpoint
curl -s -X POST https://staging.redwood.dev/lantern-poc/chat -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW" -H "X-Client-ID: lantern-prod" -d '{"conversation_id":"abc123","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Convert this bullet list to JSON"}]}'
```
Claire (Product): also add a fallback model rule: if p95 latency > 800ms or error rate > 1%, route to a smaller quantized variant and record the event for SLA reporting.
Omar (Security): flag: Lantern's infosec requires subprocessor agreement before sending any production logs off their network. we'll need to remove PII from staging logs or redact at ingest.
Riya (AE): action items: Nikhil to deliver harness + first diff by Fri EOD. Priya to confirm perf run and share IPs (done). Omar to draft security responses and call out non-negotiables. Jason to put POC credit proposal in writing and share with Lantern. Claire to finalize fallback routing proposal.
Jason (Sales): sending proposed POC quote now. will cc Legal if they want to change deletion SLA.
Nikhil (Solutions Eng): small note - we should timestamp tokenization differences in the report so legal/sales understand why some micro-deltas happen.
Priya (SRE): perf run log will be uploaded to the link above after the window. infra-bot will annotate any autoscaling events.
infra-bot: perf test scheduled: 2024-05-10T02:00:00Z. results will be available in 3 hours after run completion.
Omar (Security): drafting answers and will post by EOD. flagging deletion SLA as potential blocker.
Riya (AE): great. scheduling a 25m sync Mon 09:30 PT to review diffs + security gaps. please bring red/amber/green status for acceptance gates. :calendar:
